# Words — the index

Every word (block), its variants, modifiers and keys, each with the ≤60-character
info line `az explain` prints, and the file to edit for each concern. Read this
first when asked to change a block; open the word's README and spec for the
rules behind it.

`packages/words/test/words-index.test.ts` regenerates this file and fails when
the committed copy differs, so it always matches the code.

## Step 1: colour

Every site starts with colour, before any section is written (PRD §6.1a): pick the
theme, the accent (one hue, or an allowed pair for a gradient) and the pattern from the
user's brand or mood, and confirm them with the user. Then the frame (`width`, `font`),
then the sections — the words below. Colours come only from the theme: there is no hex
value or colour name to write, in a `.az` file or in a word (`pnpm lint`).

```az
site aurora
  theme midnight
    accent violet blue
    pattern glow top
```

`az explain theme` lists the themes and `az explain theme accent` the pairs. The legal
values, from the compiler's own tables:

- `theme <name>`, under `site`; without it the site gets `midnight`:
  - `midnight` — Dark-native, near-black ground, one electric accent
  - `paper` — Light editorial: warm paper, ink type, oxblood accent
  - `signal` — High-contrast industrial: square edges, orange accent
  - `clay` — Warm and crafted: cream ground, serif type, terracotta
  - `petal` — Soft and friendly: lavender ground, rounded type, violet
  - `volt` — Loud and graphic: black on white, heavy type, hot magenta
- `accent <hue> [<hue2>]`, under `theme`; without it the theme keeps its own accent. Hues: `violet` `indigo` `blue` `teal` `green` `lime` `amber` `orange` `rose`. A second hue makes a gradient, allowed only with these partners:
  - `violet` with blue, teal, orange, rose
  - `indigo` with teal, rose
  - `blue` with violet, teal
  - `teal` with violet, indigo, blue, green, lime, amber
  - `green` with teal, amber (not signal/volt)
  - `lime` with teal, amber, orange, rose
  - `amber` with teal, green (not signal/volt), lime, rose
  - `orange` with violet, lime, rose
  - `rose` with violet, indigo, lime, amber, orange
- `pattern <shape> [<origin>]`, under `theme`; without it there is none. Origins: `top` `bottom` `left` `right` `center` (default `top`). Shapes:
  - `none` — No background pattern
  - `glow` — Accent light blooming from one edge
  - `spotlight` — A soft circle of accent light at the origin
  - `ramp` — Directional accent fade away from the origin
  - `grid` — Perpendicular accent hairlines
  - `hatch` — Diagonal accent hairlines
  - `dots` — Accent dot lattice

## Where a change goes

| Request | Edit |
|---|---|
| The words on a page, which blocks, their order | the site's `.az` file — `az explain <term>` for any term, `az check` after |
| What a key accepts, its bounds, its info line | `packages/words/<word>/word.json` |
| One word's markup, layout or responsive styles | `packages/words/<word>/emit.web.ts` (its `@az` header names the functions) |
| Colours, spacing, type for every word | `packages/theme/src/themes.ts` (theme data), `packages/theme/src/tokens.ts` (scales) — words read tokens only |
| Buttons in every word | `packages/target-web/src/actions.ts` (the button primitive) |
| Menus, disclosures, carousel, lightbox, billing, reveal | `packages/overlay/src/runtime/behaviours.ts` |
| 3D (hero `3d`, scene, gallery `orbit`) | `packages/scene-runtime/src/runtime/` |
| Sign-in forms in the browser | `packages/auth-runtime/src/runtime/form.ts` |
| A validation rule kind shared by words | `packages/core/src/checks.ts`; the rule itself stays data in `word.json` `checks` |

Gates for any word change: `pnpm verify` (unit, typecheck, this index), `pnpm lint`
(theme tokens), `pnpm gate words/<word>` (the 12-point gate, browsers), and
`pnpm thumbnails <word> --verify`. CONTRIBUTING.md says which to run when.

## `auth`

[README](../packages/words/auth/README.md) · [spec](auth-block-spec.md) · terms: `az explain auth`

### Variants

| Variant | Info | Preview |
|---|---|---|
| `login` (default) | Email/password sign-in for returning users | `preview.az` |
| `signup` | Account creation form with a terms link | `preview.signup.az` |
| `reset` | Request a reset link, then set a new password | `preview.az` with the variant swapped in |

### Modifiers

| Modifier | Info |
|---|---|

### Keys

| Key | Kind | Values | Default | Info |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adapter` | enum, site level, required | `hosted` / `session` / `azbackend` / `custom` |  | Which auth service handles the form (site level) |
| `profile` | enum, site level | `standard` / `token-endpoint` | `standard` | Protocol the hosted adapter speaks (site level) |
| `title` | string |  |  | Form heading, the page h1; defaults per flow |
| `sub` | string |  |  | Line of text under the heading |
| `methods` | list | `password` / `link` / `oauth` | `password` | Sign-in methods offered: password, link, oauth |
| `redirect` | route |  |  | Page to open after a successful sign-in |
| `terms` | route |  |  | Terms page linked from the signup form |
| `impl` | path, site level |  |  | Path to the custom adapter module (site level) |
| `protect` | list, site level |  |  | Routes that require a signed-in user (site level) |
| `alt` | child (max 2) |  |  | Link to a sibling flow, e.g. sign up or reset |
